audit.why: Lane difficulty framing matches the data: 52.42% Emerald+ over 372 games, FAV, 7.5/10. Ryze owns level 1 with Overload poke (1000 range, 5s cooldown) while Camille has one ability; Camille takes over from level 2-3 once Hookshot and the Precision Protocol recast are online. Side lane and split favour Camille; teamfights favour Ryze's scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase is marked side "Ryze" (rating 3/10) while its own "why" text describes Camille's R isolating him — the entry contradicts itself, and content win[4] repeats the same 'Ryze' call.
audit.why: At 6 Ryze gains Realm Warp: a 180s-at-rank-1 utility ult with no combat power in a 1v1. Camille gains The Hextech Ultimatum, a 140s point-and-click anchor that removes his only disengage. Level 6 is a Camille spike, not a Ryze one. Camille's other spikes (level 2 Hookshot, Sheen/Trinity first item) are stated correctly.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to side Camille at 7/10, with the why and content win[4]/whys[4] restated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text attributes Camille's passive to Ryze — "all-in through his Adaptive Defense and his shield". Adaptive Defenses is Camille's own passive. The name is also singular where Riot's is plural, and the R is written without its article.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon names Camille's passive Adaptive Defenses and her R The Hextech Ultimatum. Ryze's shield comes from his passive Arcane Mastery, not from any Camille ability. The real interaction worth stating is the Rune Prison cooldown (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) against Camille's Hookshot (16/15/14/13/12s) — his root is up far more often than her dash, which is why baiting it rather than dashing into it is the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Passive re-attributed to Camille and named Adaptive Defenses; R named The Hextech Ultimatum; Rune Prison's 11s and Realm Warp's 180s cooldowns stated so the sequencing advice is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Rune Prison as the matchup-defining cooldown but gives no duration, so "bait it" has no timer attached.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and only 9s at rank 5 — short enough that waiting it out mid-trade is not a plan; you have to make him spend it. Camille's Hookshot is 16s at rank 1, so a wasted E costs more than a wasted root.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added for Rune Prison, Hookshot and The Hextech Ultimatum.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states what happens if Ryze roots Camille during her R dash.
audit.why: Riot's own text for The Hextech Ultimatum describes a dash to a target, not a channel; the kit's derived "channel" flag contradicts that description and is a tooltip-parsing misfire. I will not assert that Rune Prison cancels the R, and I cannot verify from the kits whether the anchor still applies if she is CC'd mid-dash.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum locks Ryze in the arena so he can't realm-warp away or kite out of your Q burst — but his W root plus Flash can still stall long enough to reset, so only commit with summoners up.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors Ryze in the arena, and his 180s Realm Warp can't answer it — but Rune Prison is back every 11s and Flash still stalls the reset, so only commit with summoners up.

edits.before: Your lethality/bruiser spike plus boots lets you all-in through his Adaptive Defense and his shield before his Tear stacks and Rod of Ages come fully online — force kills now while you out-trade him.
edits.after: Your lethality/bruiser spike plus boots lets you all-in behind your own Adaptive Defenses shield and through his, before his Tear stacks and Rod of Ages come fully online — force kills while you out-trade him.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum isolates him from his realm warp, but his W root plus Flash can stall the all-in — it's a skill check, so commit only with summoners up.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum anchors him where his 180s Realm Warp can't answer — bait the 11s Rune Prison first, then leap and he has no exit from the arena.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — Ryze can sit back and chip you with Q (Overload) while you have one ability and no all-in, so just last-hit and don't walk into his E-Flux-into-W root. The lane flips the moment you hit Level 2-3: E-in, land your Q, then back off and re-cast Q for the true-damage second hit and the move-speed before his root combo recharges. Bait his W with a held E rather than dashing into it — if your Hookshot gets rooted mid-flight, you lose the whole trade and eat his full Overload follow-up.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Overload (Q) chips from 1000 range every 5s while you have one ability and no all-in, so last-hit and stay off his Spell Flux into Rune Prison. The lane flips at Level 2-3: E in, land Precision Protocol, back off and re-cast it for the true-damage second hit and the move speed. His root is only an 11s cooldown, so waiting it out never works — make him spend it on a held E instead of dashing into it, because a rooted Hookshot costs you 16s and the whole trade.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. Use the cast's brief untargetable frame to dodge Ryze's Rune Prison or burst, then focus the trapped target. Ryze is favoured here.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) anchors Ryze in a 1v1 he cannot leave, and his level-6 answer is Realm Warp on a 180s cooldown — no combat power at all. Make him spend Rune Prison, then leap. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining cooldown. His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before you E in or commit the empowered Q2. - Camille Hookshot (E): your engage, escape, and repositioning — never waste it on chip damage. - Camille R (The Hextech Ultimatum): hold it to isolate a fleeing target or to bait/dodge Ryze's key spell with the cast frame.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining, but only 11s at rank 1 down to 9s — you cannot wait it out, you have to make him spend it before you E in or commit the Q2. - Camille Hookshot (E): 16s at rank 1 versus his 11s root, so a wasted E costs more than a wasted root — never spend it on chip. - Camille R (The Hextech Ultimatum): 140s at rank 1 — hold it to anchor him off Realm Warp, not for chip damage.

notes: Camille's kit file carries a derived 'channel' flag on The Hextech Ultimatum, but Riot's own description says she dashes to a target and anchors them — no channel. _missing-interactions.json generates 'X can cancel your The Hextech Ultimatum channel' lines for several of my enemies off that flag; I am treating them as tooltip-parsing misfires and not writing them. Same for the derived 'terrain' flag on Hookshot: the description is a wall-dash with a landing knockup, it does not create terrain, so the generated 'your Hookshot shuts off their dash' lines are unsupported. Both worth fixing in tools/build-kit-library.js. The packet's suspectNames for 'Adaptive Defense', 'Hextech Ultimatum', 'Tactical Sweep' and 'Precision Protocol' are near-matches to the real names, not fabrications — the only genuine error here was attributing Camille's passive to Ryze.
